objective: Close the primary-literature, physical-endpoint, and nonlinear-row SPS-C04 preregistration blockers without executing scientific seeds.

inputs.active_question: one ordered grid-censored all-to-all versus self-only unique-capture crossover across eta
inputs.prior_endpoint_evidence: SPS-WO-05 action-headroom gate and SPS-WO-06 coupled timestep diagnostic
inputs.data_firewall: SPS-WO-07 seeds 4001-4008 remain diagnostic-only and cannot select or confirm SPS-C04

expected_artifacts: threat-oriented primary-literature veto with read status and confidence
frozen inclusive T=1.34 endpoint and exact coupled timestep mapping
all-row outcome rule and prospective analytic eligibility/error budget
versioned summary numerators, denominators, rates, and endpoint metadata
research, literature, engineering, and expansion handoffs
verification_command: PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m unittest tests.test_aggregation_runner tests.test_sps_c04_design -v && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest -q
stop_conditions: any scientific seed, eta outcome, or performance contrast is consumed
canonical.yaml is changed to make the paper endpoint appear resolved
any outcome row is removed because of clipping, reflection, fallback, rescue, or cancellation
a nonlinear threshold is weakened after observing SPS-C04 outcomes
a novelty pass is described as proof that no prior work exists
fallback_task: If novelty fails, kill SPS-C04 before seeds; if endpoint or nonlinear accounting cannot be encoded, keep preregistration blocked and repair only deterministic metadata/tests.
positive_interpretation: Authorize a separate outcome-blind work order to freeze eta grid, minimum relevant effect, simultaneous inference, fresh seeds, stopping rule, and CPU cap.
null_interpretation: Keep SPS-C04 blocked or kill it before scientific execution.
reversed_interpretation: If nearest work establishes the same claim, drop the phase-boundary novelty object rather than broadening it.

gate_outcome.literature_veto: conditional pass at confidence 0.65; residual novelty restricted to the prospectively predicted ordered benchmark-conditioned crossover and quantitative matched decomposition
gate_outcome.endpoint: pass; inclusive T=1.34 at dt=0.02 horizon 67, with exact coupled mappings 67/134/268; canonical horizon 400 remains generic only
gate_outcome.outcomes: pass; every transition and unique capture is retained regardless of nonlinear diagnostics
gate_outcome.mechanism_coverage: pass as prospective design; exact per-arm-by-eta and seed-arm thresholds encoded before outcomes
gate_outcome.engineering: 11 scoped tests and 179 full-suite tests passed; 5 optional PyTorch skips; schema v2; no immutable v1 artifact changed

scientific_status: completed outcome-blind design gate; zero scientific episodes; preregistration variables remain unfrozen
